_comment: Hide TTN fields from Home Assistant. Matched case-insensitively against decoded_payload field_id. Add patterns ending in '*' for prefix wildcard. Use 'global' for all devices, or 'devices': {'<device_id>': ['field_a']} for one device. The synthetic diagnostics '_meta_rssi', '_meta_snr', '_meta_last_seen' can also be excluded here.
